manifest.population: 24 complete affirmative clauses, balanced six each across subject, verb, object-nominal, and adjunct focus sites; focus spans range from one to four word tokens
manifest.selection: All pairs were authored and frozen before tokenizer exposure. The comparator differs only by changing every marker hyphen in the focus weld to a space, preserving words, order, punctuation, and clause meaning apart from the proposal's focus binding.
manifest.method: For each tokenizer and complete pair, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)). Average equally within each six-item focus-site stratum and equally across the four strata. The headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. File all finite outcomes once without tuning.

estimand.aggregation: equal focus-site mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the identical clause with the focus weld replaced by ordinary spaced only-placement

manifest.freeze: The API retains canonical manifest bytes before this process imports tiktoken or observes any counts.
